recognize_zh: 低倍皮膚切片中，表皮下方整個真皮被緻密、均勻的細胞浸潤填滿並包圍毛囊附屬器，表皮本身未受侵犯；這種結節狀瀰漫真皮浸潤符合皮膚肥大細胞瘤，但此倍率看不到細胞細節，需高倍與 tryptase/CD117 確認。
features: Dense, diffuse, sheet-like dermal infiltrate filling the entire dermis at low power
Infiltrate extends up to the dermoepidermal junction beneath a thin intact epidermis
Entrapped hair follicle/adnexal structures within the infiltrate
Monotonous appearance without follicle formation or necrosis
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a skin biopsy shows a dense, diffuse, monotonous infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the dermis and extending to the dermoepidermal junction, entrapping adnexal structures. The overlying epidermis is thin but not involved. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the setting of mastocytosis, this pattern is consistent with a cutaneous mastocytoma or nodular cutaneous mastocytosis; high-power examination and tryptase or CD117 immunostaining are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leukemic or lymphomatous infiltrates contain atypical blasts or lymphocytes that are CD45/CD43/MPO or lymphoid-marker positive and tryptase-negative.
JXG contains foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells at higher power and is CD68/CD163-positive.
LCH shows grooved nuclei with eosinophils, frequent epidermotropism and CD1a/langerin positivity.
